Contribution.title: Contribution
Contribution.description: One ingredient's required quantity inside a basket line (BAS-002, MEA-005).

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Explicit catalog unit code, L or KG; boxes is ambiguous.

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.description: Free-form baskets: the ingredients this line serves; amounts add up to it.

LineRule.title: LineRule
LineRule.description:
Per ingredient (CNF-036, POL-012): the customer's accepted substitutes, chosen from the
candidates the product page offers, and the price range around the agreed unit price.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of this revision's material terms (request, lines, prices, deposits, product facts, currency, mode, charges, policy version and blockers). A customer confirmation is bound to this revision and fingerprint; it excludes lookup time and stock that stays sufficient.

free_from.title: Free From
free_from.description: Allergen codes (for example AM milk, AE, AW) the product must explicitly declare free from. A product with no declaration is excluded, not assumed safe.

country_of_origin.title: Country Of Origin
country_of_origin.description: Two-letter origin codes (for example fi, se); the product must match one. A product with no recorded origin is excluded.

unsupported.title: Unsupported
unsupported.description: Customer requirements the catalog cannot verify (for example gluten-free). Each entry blocks readiness: the basket needs the customer's decision (POL-009).
